subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the combined tracker for exec/tool failure no-reply behavior, or should maintainers split the remaining work across the open placeholder and incomplete-turn canonical threads?
rationale: Current main has partially fixed the placeholder path, while related open issues and PRs already own parts of the remaining behavior; automation should not guess the final warning/fallback policy.

options.title: Consolidate First
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer triage, route placeholder-only work to the open placeholder trackers, and decide the exec-warning plus incomplete-turn contract before a new repair PR.

options.title: Make This Canonical
options.body: Use this issue as the cross-cutting tracker for the combined placeholder, warning, and no-reply failure mode, then close or link narrower satellites into it.

options.title: Queue Narrow Policy Repair
options.body: If maintainers confirm the current suppression branches are wrong, queue one focused PR for payloads.ts and incomplete-turn.ts with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Consolidate First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer triage, route placeholder-only work to the open placeholder trackers, and decide the exec-warning plus incomplete-turn contract before a new repair PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available owner signal is recent terminal-classifier and incomplete-turn policy work in the same runner surface.
